The '''SVC-700 Voice Scrambler''' was a [[Voice disguiser|voice scrambler]] produced by [[Ulkop Securities]]. It blanketed the local area with a low-frequency [[Distortion field/Legends|distortion field]] to prevent eavesdropping on private conversations.
